ast_ael_console_device.description: Device string for the console interface, e.g., Console/dsp or Zap/1.

ast_ael_outbound_trunk.description: Trunk interface string for outbound calls, e.g., Zap/g2 or IAX2/user:pass@provider.

ast_ael_outbound_trunk_msd.description: Number of MSD (Most Significant Digits) to strip from the dialed number before sending to the trunk.
